handover_report.title: EverythingAI / EverythingApp — Local MVP 88-Test Baseline Handover

repository.name: everythingAI
repository.working_branch_policy: All work happens directly on main unless the user explicitly changes this rule.

executive_summary.current_identity: EverythingAI is a local-first, source-backed AI knowledge workspace for indexing local files, extracting document text, searching, chatting, generating controlled Wiki pages, and safely preparing file organization workflows.
executive_summary.current_baseline: The local MVP is green at 88 backend tests passed, with frontend typecheck/build validated after the latest UI additions before the Wiki content-control pass.
executive_summary.strategic_shift: The Wiki/knowledge layer is now explicitly content-controlled: document body content must come from extracted source text, not from AI summaries or weak metadata.
executive_summary.pm_status: Phases 1, 2, 3, 4, and 5 are complete/validated for the local MVP baseline. Remaining work is mainly Phase 6 controlled frontend modularization and Phase 7 final documentation polish.

frontend.latest_build_observation: 1533 modules transformed; build passed after watcher status UI changes.

runtime_smoke.windows_local_ui: PASS from previous local smoke validation

phase_6_ui_polish_modularization.recommendation: Only perform small controlled UserApp responsibility extraction. Do not combine UX changes and workflow extraction in the same commit. Avoid broad refactor while MVP is green.

phase_7_documentation_finalization.recommendation: Finalize README, MVP plan, known limitations, and final validation summary around the 88-test baseline.

recommended_next_action.pm_decision: Do not add more runtime features immediately. Preserve the 88/88 baseline and finish final MVP documentation/handover.
next_steps: Update/open ticket comments with current baseline
Update README or final local MVP status doc
Optionally run frontend typecheck/build one final time after docs-only work is complete

do_not_do_next: Do not start full enterprise governance tickets as MVP work.
Do not implement the AI Organization Workspace yet unless explicitly selected as the next product track.
